chapter: Brass bands and coming to New Orleans
title: Outstanding old funeral bands
summary: Henry names the Excelsior, Arnold brass band, the original Tuxedo, and a band led by Alan as the best funeral bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now who were some of the outstanding bands for playing funerals? Who would you name?
Well, I would consider it now. What do you mean, now or?
Back when you said you were sometimes playing one every day.
Well, I was going to tell you, there was the Excelsior, I had one, the Torsita, two, Torsita, and then there was two. Just a second.
You were telling me about the outstanding bands of years ago for planned funerals.

You know, well, the best bands in life. It was the Excelsior, Arnold Brass Band, Torsita, original Torsita. I don't mean John and them young Torsita. I mean the original Torsita. Then there was the Ux Sand. And of course, Alan, he had a band of old and out there. He was pretty good, but highly average. He didn't have no way of, he said, the men managed to play with him. The way he'd do, if he'd get a job, he'd come and get me. If I'm a good man, if he's a good man, get him, I'd play him good. And other fellows didn't play so well. Didn't get no money on it. So, that's what I was playing. But I remember the Torsita, Arnold, and Sucks.
